Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressionTrainAssessment

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressionTrainAssessment
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CompressionTrainAssessment extends Object implements Serializable
Detached assessment of one converged compressor-train candidate.

Sum each compressor body's shaft power once and divide by net exported mass flow. Serial stage flows are never added as production. The assessment supports interstage cooling, HP-body speed and recycle/load-sharing candidate comparisons without running an optimizer or writing control commands. Caller-supplied margins and aggregate shaft-power budget are not OEM design limits. Shared shafts, cooler capacity, coolant power, topology/mass closure and dynamics must be checked in the enclosing ProcessSystem/ProcessModel.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

  • Constructor Details

    • CompressionTrainAssessment

      public CompressionTrainAssessment(List<Compressor> compressors, StreamInterface export, double powerBudgetKW, double targetPressureBara, double pressureTolerance, double minSurgeMargin, double minStonewallMargin, boolean requireMaps)
      Creates a detached assessment of already solved, unique compressor bodies.
      Parameters:
      compressors - compressor bodies included in this power-budget group
      export - net exported gas stream, after recycle withdrawal
      powerBudgetKW - finite positive aggregate shaft-power ceiling in kW
      targetPressureBara - finite positive required export absolute pressure in bara
      pressureTolerance - nonnegative relative export-pressure tolerance
      minSurgeMargin - required distance-to-surge fraction, e.g. 0.1 for ten percent
      minStonewallMargin - required distance-to-stonewall fraction
      requireMaps - true to reject candidates lacking active map evidence
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for empty/duplicate bodies or invalid policy limits

    • lowestSpecificEnergy

      public static CompressionTrainAssessment lowestSpecificEnergy(List<CompressionTrainAssessment> candidates)
      Selects the feasible candidate with least shaft energy per unit net exported mass. Equal energy retains original list order. Infeasible low-power candidates never win.
      Parameters:
      candidates - converged detached assessments
      Returns:
      best feasible candidate, or null when no candidate is feasible
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if candidates is null
